svg.aria-label: Cumulative incidence of brain metastasis — NSCLC, Breast, Colorectal
svg.title: Cumulative incidence of brain metastasis — NSCLC, Breast, Colorectal
svg.text: NSCLC — n = 6,457: 1,406 events, 1,967 died first, 3,084 censored · not at risk: 1,352 already had it
Breast — n = 4,723: 905 events, 956 died first, 2,862 censored · not at risk: 645 already had it
Colorectal — n = 5,439: 447 events, 1,783 died first, 3,209 censored · not at risk: 104 already had it
Gray's test across 3 cohorts: statistic 376, permutation p ≤ 5e-4 (no shuffle of 2,000 as extreme)
Cumulative incidence of the first brain metastasis after the study's day 0, with death (OS_STATUS) as a competing risk: Aalen–Johansen, 95% intervals from its
delta-method standard error. It is not 1 − Kaplan–Meier: that treats the dead as still at risk of the event and overstates incidence whenever death is common — the
table sets the two side by side. Excluded rather than counted as event-free: 2101 who already had it by day 0, 0 without follow-up. Gray's test (weight 1) by
permutation of cohort labels, 2000 shuffles, seeded; exact under the null that the cohorts share one distribution, entry times included. An event recorded from notes
or registries is only as complete as the recording.
